build_scalar_bias_forward: build a pytorch autograd function that prepends a scalar bias vector to input tensor along specified dimension
create_scalar_bias_backward: create a backward pass that extracts gradients from the biased tensor excluding the bias dimension
test_scalar_bias_function: test the scalar_bias function by applying it to a tensor and verifying the prepended bias value
refactor_scalar_bias_init: refactor the ScalarBias class to support custom bias initialization values beyond the default zero
review_scalar_bias_usage: review the ScalarBias autograd function used in self-attention mechanisms to allow attending to a bias vector
